folder.default_skip_if_already_in_library: (Default — skip if already in library anywhere)
folder.default_writes_flac_and_m4a_a_real_multi: Default writes FLAC and M4A a real multi-value artist field, which is what most scanners prefer. Pick a separator only if yours needs one flat string.
folder.every_album_folder_is_always_complete_a: Every album folder is always complete. A track on both a studio album and a compilation will exist in both folders.
folder.keep_various_artists_as_the_album_artist: Keep “Various Artists” as the album artist
folder.leave_empty_to_save_straight_into_the: Leave empty to save straight into the library folder
folder.move_takes_every_guest_out_of_the_artist: “Move” takes every guest out of the artist tag and puts them in the title instead, so a collaboration files under one artist folder.
folder.multi_disc_folder_help: Multi-disc albums get a CD1/, CD2/ folder inside the album folder, with plain track numbers. Single-disc albums are unchanged.
folder.navidrome_jellyfin_compatible_point_this: Navidrome / Jellyfin compatible — point this at your media server's music directory.
folder.no_album_folder_tracks_are_saved: No album folder — tracks are saved directly in your library folder. Good for loose singles.
folder.on_by_default_turn_it_off_to_file_each: On by default. Turn it off to file each track of a compilation under its own artist instead of one Various Artists folder.
folder.only_that_phrase_live_remix_instrumental: Only that phrase. Live, Remix, Instrumental and the rest are kept — they tell two different recordings apart.
folder.playlist_prune_orphans_ask_help: After a playlist finishes, files in its folder that the playlist no longer contains are listed so you can remove them in one click. Nothing is deleted on its own.
folder.playlist_prune_orphans_auto_help: Files in the playlist folder that the playlist no longer contains are deleted as soon as the playlist finishes. There is no confirmation and no undo.
folder.playlist_prune_orphans_off_help: Files are never removed, even when the playlist no longer contains them.
folder.playlist_renumber_help: Spotify's Liked Songs adds new songs at the top, which shifts every position. With this on, the files are renamed to match; with it off they keep the numbers they were first given.
folder.playlist_storage_library: Library structure — same as an album download
folder.playlist_storage_library_help: Playlist tracks are filed by the folder structure and filename format above, exactly like an album download. The playlist itself is still written as an .m3u pointing into your library.
folder.playlist_storage_playlist_folder_help: Playlist tracks are saved in a folder named after the playlist. The folder structure above is not applied to them.
folder.saves_storage_if_a_track_was_downloaded: Saves storage. If a track was downloaded as part of a Best Of, it won't be re-downloaded for the studio album.
folder.services_routinely_list_the_main_artist: Services routinely list the main artist twice. On by default; only affects tracks that actually repeat one.
folder.text_transforms_help: Applied to the tags written into each file and to filenames, so the two always agree. Matching is never affected — Antra still searches every service using the original title and artists, so changing anything here cannot make it download the wrong song.
folder.token_empty: Empty when the source does not provide it
folder.token_help: A token the source does not provide renders empty, and the brackets/dashes around it collapse. {today} is fixed for the whole run; {position} is the position within a playlist, not the album track number.

settings.antra_will_run_the_program_shown_above: Antra will run the program shown above on your computer after every download. Check it is what you meant — this is not undone by cancelling a download. Editing the command asks again.
settings.apple_token_help: DevTools (F12) → Network → filter amp-api.music.apple.com → copy the Music-User-Token request header. Valid for ~30 days.
settings.artwork_saved_beside_your_music_and: Artwork saved beside your music, and artwork embedded inside each track. These are independent — turning one off never affects the other.
settings.at_0_px_and_quality_90_the_downloaded: At 0 px and quality 90 the downloaded image is saved exactly as the service sent it — no re-encoding, no quality loss.
settings.automatic_retries_for_transient_failures: Automatic retries for transient failures like truncated downloads before a track is marked failed.
settings.automatically_check_your_spotify_library: Automatically check your Spotify library for new tracks and download them on a schedule. Enable sync per-playlist using the ↺ button on each card.
settings.avoid_radio_edits_and_clean_versions: Avoid radio edits and clean versions. When a track is marked explicit, Antra keeps searching if the first result looks censored.

settings.choose_one_or_more_services_to_use_auto: Choose one or more services to use. Auto uses the full resolver chain.
settings.configure_your_spotify_account_in_the: Configure your Spotify account in the section above to see your library here.
settings.confirmed_this_command_will_run_after: Confirmed — this command will run after downloads.
settings.connect_your_apple_music_account_to: Connect your Apple Music account to unlock your personal library and playlist downloads.
settings.connect_your_spotify_account_to_unlock: Connect your Spotify account to unlock your personal library, Liked Songs, podcast downloads, and scheduled auto-sync.
settings.connected_library_podcasts_and_auto_sync: ● Connected — library, podcasts, and auto-sync enabled
settings.converting_one_lossy_format_into_another: Converting one lossy format into another (e.g. AAC → MP3) loses quality twice. With this on, Antra keeps the original lossy file rather than re-encoding it. Lossless → MP3/AAC is unaffected, and so is same-format output.
settings.could_not_reach_the_antra_servers_so: ⚠ Could not reach the Antra servers, so this key could not be verified. It has been saved — it will be checked again next time you are online.
settings.cover_name_help: Most players look for cover or folder. Filename variables work here too.
settings.find_rare_or_hi_res_versions_not_on: Find rare or hi-res versions not on streaming. Requires account.
settings.free_tier: Free tier. Claim your supporter key on the website to link it to this account.
settings.free_tier_with_key: Free tier — supporter features come from your key below.
settings.how_the_date_tag_is_written_leave_this: How the date tag is written. Leave this on ISO unless you have a reason not to — Windows Media Player shows nothing useful for the other three.
settings.keep_a_hardlink_in_slskds_folder_so: Keep a hardlink in slskd's folder so files are seeded back to the Soulseek network. Zero extra disk space.
settings.key_how_to_get: Already a supporter? Your key is emailed to you automatically after your Patreon payment — paste it below. Message me on Telegram or Discord if it hasn’t arrived.
settings.key_not_needed: Your account already carries supporter tier, so you don’t need a key here. Pasting one is harmless.
settings.key_rejected: ✗ {reason} — this key will not unlock supporter features.
settings.library_not_loaded_return_to_the_home: Library not loaded — return to the home screen and click ↺ to refresh.
settings.measures_each_tracks_loudness_replaygain: Measures each track's loudness (ReplayGain 2.0, −18 LUFS) so players that support it can level volume. Album gain is written only when a whole album is downloaded in one go; playlists and partial albums get track gain. Adds a full decode pass per track. FLAC, MP3 and M4A only; skipped for Dolby Atmos.
settings.much_larger_files_jpeg_is_what_almost: Much larger files. JPEG is what almost every player expects.
settings.off_by_default_nothing_runs_until_you: Off by default. Nothing runs until you confirm the exact command below.
settings.old_car_stereos_and_hardware_players: Old car stereos and hardware players often read only ID3v1. Harmless to leave on; turn it off if a scanner is picking up the truncated 30-character version of your titles.
settings.opt_in_safety_mode_for_niche_music_antra: Opt-in safety mode for niche music. Antra uses stricter duration and confidence checks, and will fail uncertain tracks instead of downloading risky matches.
settings.patreon_promo: Need unlimited downloads, 2× faster speed, and concurrent downloads? Support on Patreon to get a supporter key with no limits — it’s emailed to you automatically after your payment.
settings.post_command_help: Run a program when a download finishes — trigger a Navidrome or Jellyfin rescan, hand the file to beets, sync a folder to a phone. Antra never passes this through a shell: the command is split into arguments first, and values like the track title are then filled into those arguments, so a song titled "; rm -rf ~" stays one harmless argument.
settings.post_command_mode_help: A library rescan or a beets import usually wants "once, after the whole album" — running it per track fires it 200 times for a 200-track release.
settings.record_antra_version_in_downloaded_files: Record Antra version in downloaded files
settings.sidecar_help: Extra description files written next to your music, from the tracks that actually landed on disk. A folder is only described when this download accounts for every audio file in it, so re-downloading one track can never shrink an album's existing sidecar. Playlists already get an .m3u.
settings.sign_in_with_your_antra_website_account: Sign in with your Antra website account. Your password is never entered into this app — the browser handles it, and this device gets its own revocable token.
settings.sp_dc_manual_help: Or paste manually: DevTools (F12) → Application → Cookies → find sp_dc. Valid for ~1 year.
settings.strict_format_never_accept_a_lower: Strict format — never accept a lower-quality substitute
settings.the_command_is_terminated_after_this: The command is terminated after this long so it can never stall a download.
settings.the_cover_stored_inside_every_track_one: The cover stored inside every track. One copy per file, so size matters far more here than for the cover file above.
settings.the_same_information_in_a_machine: The same information in a machine-readable form, for scripts and library tools.
settings.this_session_has_ended_sign_in_again: ✗ This session has ended — sign in again.
settings.tier_unknown: ⚠ Could not check your account tier right now.
settings.tier_unknown_with_key: ⚠ Could not check your account tier right now — your supporter key is active, so supporter features stay on.
settings.track_order_titles_and_isrcs_for: Track order, titles and ISRCs for foobar2000, Plex and CD-burning tools. One sheet per disc.
settings.verify_audio_matches_track: Check the audio matches the track
settings.verify_audio_matches_track_desc: After each download, compares the audio against the track's free 30-second preview and rejects the file when it is a different recording, so Antra tries another source instead. Catches files that carry the right tags but the wrong song. Costs one small preview download per track. Tracks with no preview are left alone, and an official instrumental or remix of the same recording cannot be told apart this way.
settings.when_you_ask_for_a_lossless_format_and: When you ask for a lossless format and only a lossy copy is available, fail the track instead of silently saving an MP3/AAC. Failed tracks appear in the Failed panel with a retry button and the reason.
settings.which_tags_get_written_into_each_file: Which tags get written into each file. Everything is on by default — open this only if a specific tag is causing trouble in your player or library scanner.
settings.writes_a_separate_image_next_to_the: Writes a separate image next to the audio so players like Plex, Jellyfin and foobar2000 can find it.
settings.writes_an_artist_photo_into_the_artist: Writes an artist photo into the artist folder. Only applies to the standard Artist / Album layout.
settings.writes_antra_version_antra_source_and: Writes ANTRA_VERSION, ANTRA_SOURCE and ANTRA_DOWNLOADED tags so you can find and re-fetch folders written by an older version. Invisible in normal players.
settings.your_browser_has_been_opened_sign_in: Your browser has been opened. Sign in, then enter this code:

setup.downloads_go_through_your_own_antra: Downloads go through your own Antra account. Your password is never entered into this app — the browser handles sign-in and this device gets its own revocable token.

setup.paste_a_spotify_apple_music_or_amazon: Paste a Spotify, Apple Music, or Amazon Music playlist and Antra builds your music library automatically.
setup.pick_library_folder: Please select your Music Library folder.
setup.soulseek_credentials_needed: Please enter Soulseek credentials to enable P2P lossless sourcing. You can register a free account at slsknet.org.
setup.you_can_sign_in_later_from_settings: You can sign in later from Settings — downloads need an account or a supporter key.

cover.label: Cover art
cover.note: Artwork embedded inside the file. The separate cover.jpg is above.

year.label: Year
year.note: FLAC only. Kept 4-digit whatever the date format is, because Windows Media Player reads it.

themes.buttons_links_and_highlights_lightness: Buttons, links and highlights. Lightness is fixed by the ramp, so every accent reads at the same contrast.

cards.amazon_music: Amazon Music blue, modern slate panels, and a cleaner streaming-app look.
cards.antra: Midnight jade with polished glass surfaces and a vivid aqua edge.
cards.apple_music: Apple Music with bright porcelain surfaces instead of another dark clone.
cards.artwork: Follows the cover art of whatever you are downloading or viewing. The whole surface is tinted, not just the accent.
cards.custom: Your own pairing: pick which grey the chrome is tinted toward, then pick the accent.
cards.deezer: Deezer’s neon energy, but cleaner: aubergine depth with electric violet.
cards.ember: Burnished copper, smoked cacao, and warm lounge lighting.
cards.graphite: Refined monochrome with silver ink and gallery-style restraint.
cards.ocean: Ink-blue depth with steel-blue highlights and cool contrast.
cards.qobuz: Editorial navy, hi-fi blue, and a more premium liner-note feel.
cards.spotify: Closer to Spotify itself: charcoal layers, sharp type, green only on action.
cards.sunset: Plum dusk, rose glow, and a softer golden finish.
cards.tidal: Luxury black-and-white with a restrained cool-aqua highlight.

themes.choose_from_antra_originals_or_streaming: Choose from Antra originals or streaming-service-inspired looks. Your selection saves instantly.
themes.every_theme_has_a_light_and_a_dark: Every theme has a light and a dark ground

antra.desc: The default. Fixed-width, keeps the activity log in neat columns.
antra.label: Antra Mono

dyslexic.desc: Weighted letter bottoms to reduce swapping. Applies everywhere, including the log.
dyslexic.label: OpenDyslexic

nunito.desc: Rounded and soft. Easier for long browsing sessions.
nunito.label: Nunito

system.desc: Follows your OS interface font — Segoe UI on Windows, SF on macOS.
system.label: System

themes.language_help: Antra is English-only for now. Translations are welcome: the whole interface lives in one JSON file per language. Download logs stay in English on purpose, so a bug report is readable by whoever has to fix it.
themes.language_sub: What the interface is written in
themes.only_when_whole_download_finishes: Only when the whole download finishes
themes.only_when_whole_download_finishes_sub: Silences the per-track sound — useful for large albums. The finish flourish still plays.
themes.plays_when_a_track_is_saved_click_a_card: Plays when a track is saved · click a card to hear it

blip.desc: Two quick ticks. Minimal and quiet.
blip.label: Blip

crystal.desc: FM bell with a soft sub and a short plate tail. The default.
crystal.label: Crystal

pluck.desc: Warm filtered string. Subtle enough for long album runs.
pluck.label: Pluck

themes.which_grey_every_surface_border_and: Which grey every surface, border and neutral label is tinted toward.
